name: Castle Restaurant
description: The finest dining experience at LEGOLAND Deutschland — the Castle Restaurant is a beautifully themed medieval hall in the Knights Kingdom area serving generous hot and cold buffet lunches and dinners in a spectacular setting decorated with LEGO knights, heraldic banners and castle stonework. The Castle Restaurant is part of the LEGOLAND Holiday Village Zur Tafelrunde restaurant complex and is consistently rated the best and most atmospheric dining option for families visiting the resort. The all-you-can-eat format is ideal for hungry families after a morning of rides.

name: Hungry Bear
description: A warm and inviting restaurant in the LEGOLAND Holiday Village where the whole family gathers around the LEGO campfire for cozy meals and delicious favourite dishes. Hungry Bear serves hearty Bavarian-inspired and international family food in a rustic woodland-themed setting that is perfectly suited to the LEGOLAND Holiday Village atmosphere. Particularly popular in the evenings for families staying overnight at the resort who want a relaxed dinner after a full day in the park.

name: Ninja Kitchen
description: A fun and lively Asian-inspired fast food outlet in the NINJAGO World area serving noodle boxes, Asian rice dishes, spring rolls and dumplings alongside soft drinks. The Ninja Kitchen perfectly matches the high-energy NINJAGO theme and is particularly popular with children and young adults who want something different from the standard theme park burger and schnitzel offerings. The themed decor with NINJAGO characters throughout creates an immersive dining atmosphere.

name: Pirates Taverne
description: The most atmospheric restaurant in the LEGOLAND Holiday Village — Pirates Taverne serves pirate-themed menus and snacks in a spectacular pirate setting directly connected to the Pirate Island Hotel. Breakfasts at the Pirates Taverne are included with all Pirate Island Hotel stays and are among the most enjoyable theme park breakfasts in Germany — hearty buffets served in an immersive pirate setting that gets the day off to a memorable start before the park opens.

name: Pizza Mania
description: One of the most accessible and reliably good food options in LEGOLAND Deutschland — Pizza Mania serves freshly baked pizzas with classic toppings alongside pasta dishes and salads at reasonable prices. Pizza Mania is included in the LEGOLAND combination ticket meal deals and is centrally located in the park making it one of the most convenient lunch stops. The outdoor seating area has pleasant views of the surrounding themed zones.

name: Stars Grill House
description: A popular grill restaurant serving freshly grilled burgers, steaks, chicken and sausages alongside fries, salads and cold drinks. Stars Grill House is the best option at LEGOLAND Deutschland for guests who want a proper grilled meal rather than pizza or buffet food — the quality of the grilled items is consistently well above standard theme park levels and makes this a worthwhile lunch destination on longer park days.
